content.value_statement: Domain research is slow because good names are often taken. This skill generates brandable options and guides availability checks across useful TLDs.
actual_capabilities: Generates domain name ideas from a project description and target audience.
Suggests names across TLDs such as .com, .io, .dev, .ai, .app, and .co.
Ranks options with short branding reasons and practical recommendations.
Creates variations from keywords, product categories, or language preferences.
Provides pricing context for standard, premium, and taken domains.
Guides related checks for social handles, trademarks, and brand fit.
limitations: Domain availability changes quickly and should be verified before purchase.
Live availability checks require the agent to have access to current lookup tools.
Trademark guidance is informational and does not replace legal review.
Premium price estimates can differ from registrar listings.

use_cases.title: Name a New Startup
use_cases.description: Generate short, memorable names and compare .com and startup-friendly alternatives before launch.

use_cases.title: Choose a Product Domain
use_cases.description: Turn a product concept into domain options with clear reasons, variations, and extension tradeoffs.

use_cases.title: Build a Personal Brand
use_cases.description: Find professional domain ideas based on a name, role, niche, and preferred online identity.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Domain Ideas
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a short project description.
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building [project description] for [target audience]. Suggest 15 domain names across .com, .io, and .dev.

prompt_templates.title: Use Preferred Keywords
prompt_templates.scenario: Include words or themes that matter to the brand.
prompt_templates.prompt: Brainstorm domain names for [business type]. Include ideas using [keyword one] or [keyword two], and explain the strongest options.

prompt_templates.title: Compare TLD Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate which extensions fit the audience and budget.
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest domain names for [product]. Compare .com, .ai, .app, and .co options for trust, memorability, and likely cost.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Brand Shortlist
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a ranked shortlist with checks and next steps.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a ranked shortlist of domain names for [company]. Consider competitors, naming patterns, social handles, trademark risk, and next verification steps.

output_examples.input: A developer tool for saving and sharing code snippets.
output_examples.output: Top ideas include snippet.dev, codeclip.io, and snippetbox.com. The strongest option is snippet.dev because it is short, audience-specific, and easy to remember.

output_examples.input: A personal finance app for young professionals.
output_examples.output: Suggested directions include clear money terms, calm trust-focused names, and short .app options. The shortlist highlights names that are easy to say and spell.

output_examples.input: A design agency using the words pixel or studio.
output_examples.output: The output groups options by .com and creative TLDs, explains brand fit, and flags names that may need social handle checks.

best_practices: Share the project audience, tone, preferred length, and any words to include or avoid.
Ask for several TLD groups so you can compare trust, cost, and availability tradeoffs.
Verify domains, social handles, and trademarks before registering or announcing a name.
anti_patterns: Do not choose a name only because one extension appears available.
Do not skip spelling, pronunciation, and confusion checks for short names.
Do not treat estimated pricing or trademark comments as final legal or registrar data.

faq.question: Can it check live domain availability?
faq.answer: It can guide availability checks when the agent has current lookup tools. Always verify with a registrar before buying.

faq.question: Can it help with premium domains?
faq.answer: It can identify likely premium or taken domains and suggest lower-cost alternatives. Prices still need current registrar confirmation.

faq.question: Does it replace trademark research?
faq.answer: No. It can suggest trademark checks, but legal clearance should come from qualified counsel or official databases.

faq.question: Can it create names in multiple languages?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the target languages, market, and words to avoid so it can produce better options.

faq.question: Is it useful for personal domains?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest name, role, and niche-based domains for portfolios, consulting, and creator brands.
